usageNotes: Removes an SDN controller object from the cluster SDN configuration. The controller must not be referenced by any VNet zone before deletion; remove or reassign dependent zones first. After deletion, call the SDN apply operation to push the change to all nodes.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named SDN controller configuration; any zones that depend on it will lose their controller binding and SDN connectivity will break until the configuration is applied with a valid replacement.
tips: Returns null synchronously — there is no UPID; the change is staged and takes effect only after running the SDN apply endpoint.
Use the optional 'lock-token' param when coordinating concurrent SDN config changes to prevent conflicts.
Requires SDN.Allocate on /sdn/controllers — cluster-level privilege, not per-node.
